Belgrave also supplied the winner of the intermediate age group, in Jimmy McAffie. What was equally pleasing for Jim in winning this his first Championship was beating fellow clubmate Simon Holmes, who with David Harvey was running in this one as a guest.
In the Boys race, our first man home was Simon Holmes, seventh in 14m. 38s., while Jimmy McAffie was 11th in 14m. 51s., Reg Hopkins, 21st in 15m. 58s., and John Cambridge 21st in 16m. 53s.
